senses.gloss:
धय धय, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (fr. rt. धे),
drinking, sipping, sucking, (often at the end of a
comp., e. g. आस्यन्-धय, घटिन्-ध्˚, स्तनन्-ध्˚,
&c.); (आ), f. a little girl (?).

धाय, अस्, आ, अम्, or धायक, अस्, इका, अम्,
having, possessing, holding, &c.

धाय्य, अस्, m., Ved. a Puro-hita or family
priest?; (आ), f., scil. ऋच्, an additional verse inserted
in certain hymns.

1. धायस्, अस्, n. sustaining, supporting, bearing.
(For 2. धायस् see p. 454, col. 1.)

2. धायस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (for 1. धायस् see p. 453,
col. 3), Ved. nourishing, fostering, sustaining, (often in
comp., e. g. अरि-ध्˚, कारु-ध्˚, गो-ध्˚, भूरि-ध्˚,
&c.); drinking, sipping; the act of fostering, nourish-
ing, satiating, (used only in dat. धायसे in the sense
of an infinitive.)

1. धायु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. liberal; (Sāy.) possessing
power, supporting. (For 2. धायु see p. 454, col. 1.)

2. धायु, उस्, उस्, उ (for 1. धायु see p. 453,
col. 3), Ved. feeding, eating, fond of eating; (Sāy.)
holding, supporting, (as if fr. rt. 1. धा.)
